reason: Tidak ada wujud atau manifestasi visual aktif terdokumentasi. c03 menyatakan hampir tak terlihat dan tidak pernah terlihat; c06/c07 secara eksplisit menolak bentuk canid/serigala sebagai Arganão. Menggambar tubuh atau kekuatan aktif akan mengarang; ladang kosong gagal Uji Sangar.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: No image generated; do not invent bodily form or manifestation.
